title: Demonstration defending strike and protest rights after unionists' conviction
organizer: Part of FGTB mobilizations; CSC delegation present
participants_original: About 150 people, per the Brussels-Ixelles police estimate reported by BX1
threshold_50_evidence: The contemporary report says police estimated about 150 people at this single gathering, above the 50-person threshold.

actual_occurrence.summary: BX1 reports about 150 people demonstrated at midday on Thursday in Brussels.

start_date.summary: Article dated 10 December 2020 says action occurred Thursday, 10 December.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Reported estimate of about 150 at one gathering exceeds 50.

organizer.summary: Action was part of FGTB mobilizations; a CSC delegation attended.

demand.summary: Defended right to strike and demonstrate after unionist convictions; a human-rights league representative called for revision of Belgian Penal Code Article 406.

state_response.summary: No protest-day state response is described; response remains unknown.

notes: The report identifies the demand as defense of Belgian strike/demonstration rights and specifically criticizes use of Belgian Penal Code Article 406. Belga is credited as the report source; no separate independent contemporary report has yet been opened. ccode 211 is the supplied provisional planning value, not a verified official mapping.
open_questions: Reviewer to examine whether the social mobilization is one event or part of a broader FGTB sequence; do not merge other dates automatically.
Check neighboring-month continuity and any contemporaneous corroboration.
End date and violence remain unknown.

organizer: FGTB mobilization; other local groups/affiliates supporting legal appeal
threshold_50_evidence: Qu4tre reports police counted 500 at this gathering.
open_questions: Review whether the Liège and Brussels actions announced by FGTB on 10 December should be treated as one nationally coordinated multi-location event or as distinct local actions.
Police announced citations for breaching static assembly limits; exact number and execution unknown.
title: FGTB gathering supporting right to strike at Liège courthouse

actual_occurrence.summary: Qu4tre reports unionists gathered at the Liège Palace of Justice on 10 December to support an appeal against convictions of union officials.

start_date.summary: Article dated 10 December says the gathering occurred that day.

organizer.summary: FGTB-supported mobilization with hundreds of unionists backing the appeal.

demand.summary: Protesters said the judgment undermined the right to strike.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Police estimate of 500 at a single physical gathering.

state_response.summary: Police presence and announced citations for exceeding COVID static-gathering limit; no number reported.

notes: Same day as a separately reported FGTB-linked gathering in Brussels (E001). FGTB organized multi-city mobilization; local crowd count in Liège is 500. Preserve event-boundary question rather than combine attendance. Provisional ccode 211.

title: Collectif Susu demonstration against precarity in Brussels
organizer: Collectif Susu with support from Coordination of undocumented people and other movements
threshold_50_evidence: BX1 reports about 100 people at the gathering per police estimate.

actual_occurrence.summary: BX1 reports a public gathering in central Brussels on 13 December.

start_date.summary: Article date is 13 December 2020 and places action on Sunday at 16:00.

organizer.summary: Collectif Susu organized with support from undocumented-person groups and others.

demand.summary: Demonstrators opposed precarity; organizers sought regularization of undocumented people and action from state institutions on urgent needs.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Police estimate of about 100 at a single gathering.

state_response.summary: No government response is reported; unknown.

notes: No known final answer to requests is not evidence the state ignored or accommodated them. Article credits Belga for photo only, not written story origin. Provisional ccode 211.
open_questions: Reviewer to assess domestic-state targeting for regularization/social-benefit demands.
End time and protester violence not reported.

title: Search-only report of a separate 13 December gathering in Liège about the crisis and precarity
threshold_50_evidence: Unproven. Le Vif search-result title indicates a Liège gathering, but the exact article body failed to fetch and no attendance evidence was available.

actual_occurrence.summary: Le Vif search-result title reports demonstrations in Brussels and Liège on 13 December about handling and consequences of the crisis for precarious people; exact Liège details not verified.

start_date.summary: Search-result result identifies a Liège manifestation on 13 December 2020.

location.summary: Liège; exact public site not stated in search result.

demand.summary: Search-result summary associates the Liège manifestation with the crisis and precarious people.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No evidence of 50 or more; exact target and body remain unverified.

notes: Do not conflate with the same-day anti-curfew action in Esplanade Saint-Léonard reported by S006: different stated demand and no source basis for merging. The exact Le Vif page returned a technical failed fetch; no retry/bypass. ccode 211 is provisional.
open_questions: Find a permitted exact-source body or leave pending; exact site, attendance, organizer and state response unknown.
Assess whether the Liège and Brussels actions were one coordinated event or distinct local assemblies.
